data: Polar-orbit workhorse for Yaogan + Gaofen + Fengyun
Fleet launch-site entry added during the cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). TYSC LC-9 (also called Pad 9) handles most of Taiyuan's polar/SSO launches with Long March 2D / 4B / 4C / 6A.
Long March 2D / 4B / 4C polar-orbit workhorse — Yaogan, Gaofen, weather sats

Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center's LC-9 (also known as Pad 9) handles most of TYSC's polar and sun-synchronous orbit launches with the Long March 2D, 4B, 4C, and 6A. Typical payloads include the Yaogan reconnaissance series, the Gaofen Earth-observation constellation, and the Fengyun meteorological satellites. Active since 2008.
China's heavy-lift pad — Long March 5 to Tianhe, Chang'e 5/6, Tianwen-1, and the lunar return programme
Long March 7 pad on Hainan: all ten Tianzhou cargo ships to Tiangong, plus Long March 8 flights
China's crewed-spaceflight pad — every Shenzhou crew
Long March 3A/3B family — most Chinese GTO commercial launches and Beidou GNSS deployments
First CZ-3 operational successes — DFH-2 first GTO success, Apstar / Asiasat / Sinosat era
Iran's orbital launch site: Safir put Omid, Iran's first home-built satellite, in orbit in 2009
